  "CRITERIA_MATCH_EXPLANATION": "The paper focuses on regional curriculum harmonization initiatives in Africa, specifically examining the SADC region. The paper explicitly mentions the SADC Protocol on Education and Training and its implications for harmonization.",
  "Title": "Curriculum Harmonisation in the SADC Region: Progress, Prospects, and Challenges",

    ]
  },
  "KEY_FINDINGS": {
    "Main_Findings": [
      "Progress has been made in developing regional frameworks for curriculum harmonization in the SADC region.",
      "Implementation of these frameworks faces several challenges.",
      "Harmonization efforts aim to improve the quality and relevance of education and training in the region.",
      "Mutual recognition of qualifications is a key goal of curriculum harmonization."
    ],
    "Challenges_Barriers": [

      "Research is needed to explore the role of technology in facilitating curriculum harmonization."
